_doc: build 29 Forge characters: THE one place that says which finished model each playable Forge character is built from. To drop in a newer model (the Phase A3 heads, or any later Forge pass), point its "source" at the new .blend (exported by export_char.py) or at a folder holding lod0.glb and lod1.glb, then run tools/forge_chars/install.sh <key> on the farm and re-export the pck. "playable" false = its rig did not pass add_hero.sh's clip gate: kept here with the reason, never installed, never pickable (fight.gd FORGE_CAST and features/waleui/characters.ts list the playable ones).

forge_bram.why: add_hero.sh gate: rig tears in every clip (idle 1.6 %, jog 3.6 %, worst 7.5 % of triangles past 2.5x; gate 0.5 %), mostly the outfit at the armpits, the belt pouches beside the hands and the crotch

forge_catboy.name: Cat-Boy
